rationale: The stock is trading near its 9-EMA and session high after a massive 16% gap-up, indicating that the initial momentum has been absorbed and price is consolidating. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward ratio due to the proximity to the high (limited upside before hitting resistance) and the risk of a mean-reversion pullback to VWAP, while shorting a strong earnings beat with high relative volume is counter-trend and high-risk.
